    - text: CLASS 12 · FORMAL CALCULUS
    - heading "Approximation Using Differentials" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Use differentials to approximate function values near a point by the equation of the tangent line.
    - text: 16 min ADVANCED CONCEPT LAB
    - navigation:
      - radio "Tangent Approximation Lab" [checked]
      - text: Tangent Approximation Lab
      - radio "Learn"
      - text: Learn
      - radio "Worked Example"
      - text: Worked Example
      - radio "Practice"
      - text: Practice
      - radio "Summary"
      - text: Summary
    - heading "TANGENT APPROXIMATION LAB" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Explore how the tangent line at x=a approximates y=f(x) near x=a.
    - text: FUNCTION
    - status "FUNCTION": f(x)=√x
    - text: BASE POINT a
    - spinbutton "Base point a": "4"
    - text: f(a)=√4=2 CHANGE dx
    - slider "Change dx": "0.1"
    - status: "0.1"
    - text: x=a+dx=4.1
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - article:
      - heading "GRAPH" [level=3]
      - img "Square root tangent approximation graph":
        - slider "Graph changed x point"
        - text: (4, 2) (4.1, √4.1)
      - button "Zoom in graph":
        - img
      - button "Zoom out graph":
        - img
      - button "Fit graph":
        - img
      - text: Δy is the actual change; dy is the tangent-line differential.
    - article:
      - heading "VALUES AT x=a+dx=4.1" [level=3]
      - paragraph: f(a)=√4 = 2
      - paragraph: Actual value f(a+dx)=√4.1 = 2.02485
      - paragraph: Actual change Δy=f(a+dx)−f(a) = 0.02485
      - paragraph: Derivative f'(x)=1/(2√x)
      - paragraph: f'(4)=0.25
      - paragraph: Differential dy=f'(a)dx = 0.025
      - paragraph: Tangent approximation f(a+dx)≈f(a)+f'(a)dx = 2.025
      - separator
      - heading "ERROR ANALYSIS" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Absolute error |Δy−dy| = 0.00015
      - paragraph: Percentage error |Δy−dy|/|Δy|×100% = 0.62%
    - heading "SEE ERROR SHRINK" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Decrease dx to see the approximation improve.
    - button "Play shrinking dx":
      - img
    - slider "Error shrink dx": "0.1"
    - text: Animation speed
    - button "1x"
    - button "2x"
    - button "4x"
    - article:
      - heading "LINEAR APPROXIMATION FORMULA" [level=3]
      - paragraph: For a differentiable function f at x=a,
      - text: f(a+dx)≈f(a)+f'(a)dx
      - paragraph: This is the equation of the tangent line at x=a.
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Near x=a, the curve y=f(x) is well approximated by its tangent line. The smaller dx, the smaller the error.
    - article:
      - heading "WHEN TO BE CAREFUL" [level=3]
      - paragraph: If |dx| is large, the curve bends significantly and the tangent line no longer gives a good approximation.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE (CORRECT)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Estimate √4.10 using differentials with a=4.
      - list:
        - listitem: f(a)=√4=2
        - listitem: f'(4)=1/4=.25
        - listitem: f(4+.1)≈2+(.25)(.1)=2.025
        - listitem: Actual √4.10≈2.02485
        - listitem: Absolute error≈.00015; percentage error≈.60%
    - complementary:
      - heading "CHECK" [level=3]
      - paragraph: (√4.10)²=4.10 ✓
      - paragraph: (2.025)²=4.100625
      - text: close to 4.10
    - heading "PRACTICE TASK" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Estimate ∛27.3 using differentials with a=27.
    - article:
      - text: Use f(x)=∛x.
      - paragraph: a=27, dx=.3
    - article:
      - heading "Hint" [level=4]
      - paragraph: f'(x)=1/(3x^(2/3))
